title: Algebraic Retrieval: Composable Search for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.19482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Algebraic Retrieval lets AI agents compose search strategies at query time. Relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences can be expressed together in a mathematical query. The query surface exposes available operations, so an agent can combine them for the question at hand and revise a program after inspecting results. We evaluate execution parity, not agent behavior or retrieval quality. Building on Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM), which exposes vector and score arithmetic during retrieval, we demonstrate contrastive scoring, candidate-pool reranking, and weighted ranking as composable queries, alongside executable SQL and PyTerrier counterparts. On the public 11,429-document Vaswani fixture, each program's implementations select the same document set with score differences below 1e-6; one tied pair orders differently across scoring paths.

translated_title: 代数检索：面向智能体的可组合搜索
translated_abstract: 代数检索使AI智能体能够在查询时组合搜索策略。相关性标准、资格约束和排序偏好可以在一个数学查询中共同表达。查询接口暴露了可用的操作，因此智能体可以根据当前问题组合这些操作，并在检查结果后修订程序。我们评估的是执行一致性，而非智能体行为或检索质量。基于程序化嵌入调制（PEM）——它在检索过程中暴露向量和分数运算——我们展示了对比评分、候选池重排序和加权排序作为可组合查询，并提供了可执行的SQL和PyTerrier对应实现。在公开的11,429篇文档的Vaswani测试集上，每个程序的各实现选择出相同的文档集合，分数差异低于1e-6；其中一对分数相同的文档在不同评分路径下的排序存在差异。
tldr: 本文提出代数检索方法，让AI智能体能在查询时通过数学查询组合相关性标准、资格约束和排序偏好来构建可组合的搜索策略，并在公开测试集上验证了其与SQL和PyTerrier对应实现之间的执行一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Algebraic Retrieval, which enables AI agents to compose search strategies at query time by combining relevance criteria, eligibility constraints, and ranking preferences in mathematical queries, and demonstrates execution parity with executable SQL and PyTerrier implementations on a public test fixture.
